data.description: Casting goodberry makes 2d4 freshly picked berries magical. You [as well as any other druid of 3rd or higher level] can immediately discern which berries are affected. Each transmuted berry provides nourishment as if it were a normal meal for a Medium creature. The berry also cures 1 point of damage when eaten, subject to a maximum of 8 points of such curing in any 24-hour period.
